commits.message: A contrast sampling with no moments is refused instead of reported as an infinite contrast (rich-unfiled-791c.f6wx)
ContrastSampling is declared before CONTRAST and described once (rich-unfiled-791c.f6wx)

The markdown linearity and effects-feel contrast tests do a fraction of the work, so a saturated suite stays clear of the hang limit (rich-unfiled-791c.f6wx)

Markdown: each expectLinearTime starts just above the helper's floor (7.3s -> 0.9s calm).
effects-feel: runDemo takes the contrast sampling as a defaulted argument; the one test that waits for every loop to be measured asks for one period at 12 moments (6.2s -> under 1.5s). Mutant (a loop left unmeasured) and quadratic-reader mutant both went red.

Underline kinds 4:1–4:5 and underline color 58 as Style fields (6ch.nc7) (#602)

* Underline kinds and color as Style fields (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.nc7): Style.underline holds one kind (single, double, curly, dotted, dashed) so the later style decides it whole, doubleUnderline gone; underlineColor (SGR 58); one UNDERLINE table read by the encoder, decodeAnsi, parse, toString and template bindings; whether a destination draws 4:3-4:5 and 58 is picked once per console (style-effects.ts) and held on OutputTarget.underlines, a plain underline and no color otherwise; HTML and SVG draw wavy, dotted, dashed and colored lines

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Underline review fixes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.nc7): an effect that moves a cell's ink draws its colored underline in it; SVG blinks by opacity so own-paint lines blink; reset and withoutColor clear underlineColor; underline decisions leave the send log; blink on underline keeps the cell's kind; underlineColor template sink; Windows Terminal 1.20 reads 4:n and 58; style.md example declares what the example terminal draws

* Medium review on underline kinds (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.nc7): HTML blink fades the decoration color so a run blinks whole like SVG, outline included in both; a non-kind underline refused at construction; UNDERLINE rows carry styled, read by the encoder and decodeAnsi; an effect writes 59 only over an underline color of its own; dim fades an underline's own color; docs say underline decisions sit on OutputTarget.underlines, not onSend

* Second high review (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.nc7): a reversed cell's ink is its background slot when an effect decides the underline color; a terminal nothing weighed gets plain underlines from resolveOutputTarget; not <kind> takes only that kind off within a definition; styled UNDERLINE rows derive 4:n from n; decodeAnsi and style docs updated
